webkitMemorySupplement.limitation: One fresh browser launch, sampled summed RSS including shared mappings; not unique physical memory, no proof transient peaks were captured, no regression variance estimate. Attribution is by fresh PID/exact executable bundle/time window, not OS audit-token parent proof.
webkitMemorySupplement.workload: Seven corpus loads with exact raw roundtrip, initial full DOM layout, a reset and 33 native DOM keys each. Excludes adaptive microbench allocation bursts and repeated 20x full rebuild; not substituted into the main-series RSS.
